people.name: NESPITAL, Helmut – Persons of Indian Studies by Prof. Dr. Klaus Karttunen

relations.subject: Helmut Nespital
relations.evidence: Studied from 1955 at Humboldt University in Berlin (East), began with philosophy, but soon turned to Oriental languages (Indian, Persian, Turkish, Arabic). M.A. 1960 Berlin.

relations.subject: Helmut Nespital
relations.evidence: Then further studies of Hindi under Pořízka at Prague.

relations.subject: Helmut Nespital
relations.evidence: In 1965-77 taught Hindi at Humboldt University.

relations.subject: Helmut Nespital
relations.evidence: Habilitation 1977 Humboldt University in modern Indian languages.

relations.subject: Helmut Nespital
relations.evidence: From 1980 PD at Freie Universität Berlin.

relations.subject: Helmut Nespital
relations.evidence: From 1982 Professor für allgemeine Sprachwissenschaft at Bamberg

relations.subject: Helmut Nespital
relations.evidence: from 1990 Professor of Indology (New Indian Languages) at Freie Universität Berlin.
